buildCommand: curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain nightly-2025-01-07 && source "$HOME/.cargo/env" && curl https://rustwasm.github.io/wasm-pack/installer/init.sh -sSf | sh && cargo install just && corepack enable && (yarn install --immutable || yarn install) && just build && (cd packages/web-wallet && yarn build)
